m02 3D (z = the given-ness of the world): the pole walks deeper (z +0.1 → −0.55) as 'the opening' → 'never an object' while three given marks hold nearer depths — depth is the world given through the opening, and the deepest term is never reached as an object; depth LFO = the given field breathes. m03 the cut: the walker steps cut → knowable gift → field forgotten (darkens red: the danger the record marks) while the broken token's two pieces hold apart at attract 0.5 — they signify by relation, not fusion; saw LFO on turbulence = the cut's edge.

m04 the formal limit: the system's attempt 'every condition made internal' still ends in 'a remainder' held outside by a repel force — the movement's exact claim; vortex pointer = the internal swirl that never closes on its own condition.

m05 diaphaneity as demand and method only: light → refracted → the prism visible, with two colour bands the prism makes possible. The mathematical disclosure (180°→360°) is deliberately NOT staged here — it waits for room-04 movement-25 (withholding kept).

glyph_rationales.the panel — three readings on one needle: M01: the record's own image — an instrument panel whose readings r₁ r₂ r₃ depend on what it does not display
glyph_rationales.the observer: M01: the observer the readings presuppose — the one for whom distinctions matter, whom planetary systems displace
glyph_rationales.the situation: M01: the situation of the reading — prompt, memory, permissions: operatively constitutive context, drawn as the ground the panel stands on
glyph_rationales.the dice field — thirty-six ordered stat: M02: the movement's Derived figure — a pair counted three ways (36 ordered, 21 unordered, 11 totals): each number answers a different question
glyph_rationales.the knower: M02: pramātṛ — the indefinitive pole present in knowing, never exhausted as another known
glyph_rationales.the means: M02: pramāṇa — the seeing through which knower and known become available together; the compressed triad inside 'I see the world'
glyph_rationales.the known: M02: prameya — the definitive pole of what can be made known; real without being self-disclosing apart from the relation
glyph_rationales.the field and the cut: M03: determination as negational and productive — the mark ▓ exists by excluding the field ·; the cut's gift, then its danger when only the term is left (red)
glyph_rationales.the kept piece: M03: the symbolon's retained half — the broken token signifies by relation, not fusion
glyph_rationales.the absent answer: M03: the token's absent counterpart — the relation held open rather than closed into an object
glyph_rationales.the articulate system: M04: the genealogy's box — Russell, Gödel, Wittgenstein, Spencer-Brown/Varela each closing terms internal; the re-entry arrow drawn crossing its own boundary
glyph_rationales.the remainder: M04: what cannot be converted — held outside the box by a repel force: the system cannot make its own conditions internal without remainder
glyph_rationales.the circle: M04: Cusa's circle — infinite form the polygon measures toward
glyph_rationales.the polygon: M04: Cusa's polygon — finite measure approaching the circle while the difference stays
glyph_rationales.the apparatus — one eye-point, one plane: M05: Dürer's draughtsman — perspective as apparatus: one eye-point, one frame-plane, the world reduced to what that position records
glyph_rationales.the colour the prism makes possible: M05: the prism becomes visible in the colour it makes possible — diaphaneity's demand, drawn as the bands the refraction alone yields
glyph_rationales.the counting and its condition: M06: the QL anchor — 0 marks the condition under which counting occurs; every counted item occupies the position 1; the enfolded whole active in each local unfolding
glyph_rationales.zero — the promissory ring: M06: zero as promissory meta-sign — the open place in the score, gold because it is offered, not argued
